repos_data.description: One wiki for all your agents. The server behind dexio.wiki: MCP, the web app, history and sharing.

MCP server: check a folder of markdown against Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.2 and JidoSeal-defined Bronze/Silver/Gold frontmatter tiers (not ISO certification), locally, from Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Gemini CLI or a local model. Engine proprietary; no-egress is a vendor claim, see README.
